test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following interchange of numbers and mathematical signs would make the given equation correct?

28 + 7 × 10 ÷ 5 - 20 = 5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Point__

__
 
• **Please note that, in this kind of question we have to replace the digits on the right-hand side too that's why 5 is replaced by 10 in the given solution.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given equation : **28 + 7 × 10 ÷ 5 - 20 = 5**

According to the question, after** ****interchanging of numbers and mathematical signs:**

So,

 
• Option - (1) : 10 and 20, × and +

28 × 7 + **20 ÷ 5**__ - 10 = 5

__**28 ×**____** 7**__ + 4 - 10 = 5

__**196 + 4**__ - 10 = 5

__**200 - 10**__ = 5

190 ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (2) : 5 and 20, - and ÷

28 + 7 × 10 - **20 ÷ 5**__ = 20

28 + __**7 × 10**__ - 4 = 20

__**28 + 70**__ - 4 = 20

__**98 - 4**__ = 20

94 ≠ 20 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (3) : 7 and 28, × and ÷

7 + **28 ÷ 10**__ × 5 - 20 = 5

7 + __**2.8 ×**____** 5**__ - 20 = 5

__**7 + 14**__ - 20 = 5

__**18 - 20**__ = 5

-2 ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : 5 and 10, + and ÷

**28 ÷ 7**__ × 5 + 10 - 20 = 10

__**4 × 5**__ + 10 - 20 = 10

__**20 + 10 **__- 20 = 10

__**30 - 20**__ = 10

10 = 10 (LHS = RHS)

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
